title: October 2023 TCS change for LRS remittances
sourceIndicatorId: Ministry of Finance press release, June 28, 2023

rows.purpose: LRS purposes other than education or medical treatment
Education or medical treatment, other than education financed by specified loan

metadata.method: Transcribed from the Finance Ministry's June 28, 2023 implementation table.
metadata.interpretation: TCS is tax collected at source and normally available as tax credit. It can create an upfront cash-flow cost, but it is not automatically the remitter's final tax liability.
metadata.honestyRule: The event date can be aligned with monthly LRS data, but the alignment does not identify a causal effect.
